summary.text: Gary Gilmore is a Democratic state representative for New Hampshire House of Representatives Strafford 16 who took office in December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is a researcher by profession.

paragraphs.text: Gilmore was born in New Hampshire and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of New Hampshire.
His career experience includes working as a researcher.
Gilmore advanced from the Democratic primary for Strafford 16 on September 10, 2024, and defeated Diana Day in the general election on November 5, 2024; he succeeded Gail Pare.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026.
